English or Chinese is welcome. You do not need to fix both versions. / 中文或英文均可，不要求两语一起修改。

Location name and region; ID if known / 地点名称和地区，知道ID可附上:
Language / 语言:
Game build and mod version / 游戏与模组版本:
Current text or screenshot / 当前文本或截图:
Proposed correction and reason / 建议修改及理由:
Supporting source and revision / 资料与修订链接:

What did you check? A page link is enough for an initial report. / 初次反馈有页面链接即可，不必先查修订号。

Please distinguish the settlement from the wider region. Do not post personal information or credentials. / 请区分聚落和周边地区，不发个人信息或凭据。
